descriptions.env.cdp: the automation protocol serialized a console argument (Runtime.enable is on)
descriptions.env.driver_globals: globals left by browser drivers are present
descriptions.env.headless_ua: the browser reports HeadlessChrome in navigator.userAgent
descriptions.env.probe_missing: a correct proof-of-work arrived without a valid probe result for its challenge
descriptions.env.engine_mismatch: the rendering engine found by feature tests is not the one the user agent claims
descriptions.env.ua_mismatch: navigator.userAgent differs from the request User-Agent
descriptions.env.hints_mismatch: client hints contradict the user agent or the browser's own report
descriptions.env.perm_inconsistent: notification permission is denied while the permissions API says prompt
descriptions.env.window_zero: the outer window has zero size or the window is larger than the screen
descriptions.env.software_gl: graphics are rendered in software (no GPU)
descriptions.env.tz_mismatch: the time zone does not belong to the address's country
descriptions.req.no_accept_language: the request has no Accept-Language header
descriptions.transport.ja4_mismatch: the proxy-reported JA4 belongs to another browser family than the one claimed
descriptions.transport.ja4_tool: the proxy-reported JA4 belongs to a known HTTP tool, not a browser
descriptions.profile.uniform: a uniform privacy profile (Tor Browser, resistFingerprinting): time zone, language and screen checks skipped
descriptions.attest.returning_device: the browser presented a valid returning-device token (spec 008)
descriptions.behavior.missing: the hold step was required but its input is missing, invalid or bound to another challenge
descriptions.behavior.untrusted: input events were not produced by a real input device
descriptions.behavior.teleport: the pointer pressed the control with almost no movement before it
descriptions.behavior.straight: the pointer approached the control along a straight line
descriptions.behavior.machine_timing: pointer samples arrived at machine-regular intervals
descriptions.behavior.smooth_curve: the pointer path is a smooth single-curvature curve without micro-corrections
descriptions.behavior.exact_center: the pointer pressed the exact centre of the control
descriptions.behavior.exact_hold: the hold lasted exactly the required time
descriptions.behavior.no_key_repeat: a key hold of the control produced no operating-system auto-repeat
descriptions.behavior.still_touch: a touch hold of the control did not move at all
descriptions.behavior.press_in_motion: the pointer pressed the control while still moving towards it
